opinions.text:
Application to vacate stay of execution of sentence of death entered by the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit on October 23, 2012, presented to Justice Thomas, and by him referred to the Court, denied.
The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
